signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E in Aug 2025 at a $2.2B valuation, doubled headcount past 300, surpassed $100M ARR, and is hiring hundreds to expand across housing and healthcare

email.body1:
Michael, saw EliseAI closed its $250M Series E and is hiring hundreds to expand across housing and healthcare.

Growth that fast means follow-up volume usually outpaces what the SDR team can handle, and slow response speed is where good leads quietly die. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps focus on live conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up.

Most SDR teams lose more pipeline to slow or skipped follow-up than to bad targeting. Reps burn hours on research, writing, and CRM logging, so the leads that matter get touched late, and response speed slips right when it counts.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting follow-up load and ramp time isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling a team this fast is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I'll tailor it to EliseAI either way.
